recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the work group wants additional snapshot-behavior annotations on individual extensions, handle that in the FHIR Tools IG and/or FHIR Extension Pack, following FHIR-56447 and related extension-pack work rather than changing core.
issue_request: FHIR-28441 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for a StructureDefinition extension to let extension authors declare how an extension should be inherited by snapshot generators. The approved resolution called for a 0..1 code extension on StructureDefinition with inheritance behavior codes.
initial_application: Core commit 4944ac0e152e765dca53d9ac5cec51f3fb88da7c applied the issue by adding structuredefinition-inheritance-control, inheritance-control-code CodeSystem/ValueSet, and StructureDefinition implementation guide references under source/structuredefinition. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source tree as part of moving extensions out of core.
additional_context: FHIR-27535 was resolved No Change/Not Persuasive because FHIR-28441 supplied the accepted solution, and FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-28441 as the survivor with an 11-0-0 persuasive-with-modification vote. Current core source contains only OID registry entries for the legacy inheritance-control URLs. The FHIR Extension Pack contains the moved structuredefinition-inheritance-control artifact, and the FHIR Tools IG contains the active tools snapshot-behavior extension and ignore/add/defer/overwrite code system. Later discussion and FHIR-56447 show that applying snapshot-behavior to specific extension definitions is ongoing external-repo work.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source file was changed. The seed was decided with an empty external-repo audit commit because the current maintained artifacts are outside this core checkout and a core edit would duplicate or alter out-of-build source.
